fields.label: Risk per trade
fields.help: A full stop-out costs this share of the account. 0.01 is 1%. Above 2% a normal losing streak becomes an account-ending one.

fields.label: Max open positions
fields.help: Ceiling on concurrent trades. The correlation and risk caps are what actually bound risk; this bounds attention.

fields.label: Max position size
fields.help: No single position may exceed this share of equity, however tight its stop.

fields.label: Max correlation
fields.help: Refuse a new trade moving this closely with something already held. Stops three tickers becoming one bet at triple size.

fields.label: Max gross exposure
fields.help: Total cost basis of open positions. Capped at 1.00: this agent never uses margin.

fields.label: Drawdown halt
fields.help: Stop opening new trades once the account is this far below its high water mark.

fields.label: Smallest worthwhile trade
fields.help: As a fraction of a normal risk unit. Below this the leftover room is better left unspent than turned into a one-share position that still costs a slot.

fields.label: Rule sets
fields.help: Which strategies may fire. They look for different things, so running all three raises trade count without doubling a bet.

fields.label: Rank candidates by
fields.help: Which setups win when more qualify than there are free slots. Most setups get discarded for want of a slot, so this matters more than most entry rules.

fields.label: Reward:risk target
fields.help: Target distance as a multiple of stop distance.

fields.label: Max hold (days)
fields.help: Close a trade that has gone nowhere for this long.

fields.label: Liquidity floor
fields.help: Thin names have wide spreads and gap hard.

fields.label: Hold uncertain trades for approval
fields.help: Off means the agent behaves exactly as it did before: clean trades submitted, vetoed trades discarded, nothing waits.

fields.label: Let me overrule a veto
fields.help: A vetoed trade becomes a proposal instead of vanishing. It still does not happen unless you approve it.

fields.label: Hold flagged trades
fields.help: Trades the research layer noted something about but did not block. This is the setting that can cost you a trade you would otherwise have taken.

fields.label: Hold when research could not run
Block trades near earnings
fields.help: An earnings report is a scheduled overnight coin flip that can gap straight through a stop.

fields.label: AI headline review
fields.help: The model can only ever block a trade. There is no path that lets it create or enlarge a position.

fields.label: Skip the trade if research fails
fields.help: On means a research outage costs you trades. Off means the agent trades without knowing whether earnings are two days out. On is the safe side.

forbidden.allow_live_trading: the paper/live switch is not a dashboard control

watchlist.label: Watchlist
watchlist.help: Add or remove tickers. Everything else stays on the list in config.py.
